tools.name: rtk
tools.notes: Token-optimized command proxy. Router rewrites grep/find/cat through rtk; rtk rewrite exit-code protocol (0/1/2/3) is version-coupled. Since 0.49.0: -l is GNU --files-with-matches under rtk grep (completing 0.47.0's -t/-m passthrough), rewrite handles safe pipes, peels process wrapper prefixes, and passes sudo commands through.

tools.name: jcodemunch
tools.notes: Indexed code search MCP server. Powers scout agent, router fallback, and Step 2.5 divert; wheel-URL uvx installs are supported transports.

tools.name: graphify
tools.notes: Knowledge graph builder. PyPI package name is graphifyy; repo moved to Graphify-Labs (safishamsi redirects); version-warns outside tested range. 0.9.53 writes no .rebuild.lock; its shrink guard keeps a partial build from overwriting graph.json, and since 0.9.53 (#3203) an unverified per-source shrink arms the guard and re-queues the source on the next run — a first run can legitimately return a smaller graph that a later run completes. Since 0.9.65 (#3697/#3695) the eviction pass re-checks the kept set, so a moved-file/symlink layout can no longer deadlock the shrink guard into refusing every update.

tools.name: headroom
tools.notes: Context-compression proxy. Repo moved to headroomlabs-ai (chopratejas redirects); detected via headroom-init-claude hook marker or localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; /savings reads `headroom perf --format json`.

tools.name: superpowers
tools.notes: Base skills framework (required). Detected via ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json; every chain skill wraps a superpowers:* skill. 6.3.0 SDD task-batching (#2078) is deliberately declined in sdd+ (per-task dispatch is load-bearing); the Spec: pointer (#2086) is emitted by plan+; brainstorming ceremony scaling (#2063) does not scale down the brain+ overlay.
